name: Extreme X TO-GO Body Rub I 250mg THC : 250mg CBD
description:
EXTREME X TO-GO Topical Body Rub 
Dosage: 250mg THC : 250mg CBD 
Activation Time: 10 - 15 minutes 
Net Weight: 5G 
Possesses an unscented natural aroma. 
Find reliable relief where it matters most. Pain may be inevitable but suffering is not! Our topical is non-transdermal, meaning it does not get you high, making it the perfect fit for all day use in any environment. 
Apply the balm directly to the affected area, gently massage until completely absorbed. Store the container in cooler temperatures and keep out of direct sunlight. Our premium product is sourced, produced, and tested locally. 
Ingredients: Coconut Oil, Beeswax, Mango Butter, Shea Butter, THC Distillate, CBD Isolate, Grapeseed oil, Frankincense essential oil, Camphor oil, Lavender essential oil, Vitamin E oil, Rosehip oil, Mineral oil, 
Helichrysum essential oil, Myrrh essential oil
